en.name: Lostream Polka
en.effect: Equip this card to 1 face-up WIND Attribute Sea Serpent Type monster on your field as an Equip Spell Card with the following effect. Then, you can add 1 Level 5 or higher WIND Attribute Sea Serpent Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. ●While the equipped monster is face-up on your field, your opponent cannot declare an attack on monsters that are not equipped with an Equip Spell Card.
